terms.note: MCP callable primitive; plural أدوات. Keep Tools when naming the Inspector UI tab, and all code identifiers unchanged.
Readable MCP data; plural موارد. A resource template is قالب مورد. Keep Resources and Resource Templates when naming actual UI tabs.

Reusable MCP message template, plural قوالب توجيه. First prose mention on a page may include (prompt). A general instruction to an LLM is توجيه; a UI confirmation prompt is مطالبة. Keep Prompts as a literal UI label.
MCP model-generation feature; first prose occurrence takes (sampling). Do not suggest it merely samples existing data. Wire identifiers remain unchanged.
Client-exposed directory roots; first prose mention takes (roots). Not mathematical roots or administrator privileges.
Server requests user input through the client; first prose mention takes (elicitation). Preserve form/URL and push/pull distinctions.
Declared protocol capability; plural قدرات. A feature is ميزة, not necessarily a declared capability.
Protocol connection mechanism; plural وسائل نقل. stdio, Streamable HTTP, and SSE stay unchanged.
Plural جلسات. Session identifiers and class names stay unchanged.
Registered handler function; plural دوال معالجة. A handler body is جسم دالة المعالجة; avoid the hardware sense of processor.
Plural اعتماديات, for packages and injected dependencies. Dependency injection is حقن الاعتماديات.
Function supplying an injected parameter. Shorten to دالة الحل after the role is clear; preserve Resolve identifiers.
Plural عملاء; the MCP component inside a host, distinct from the user and host application.
Plural خوادم. Class and module names remain unchanged.
The user-facing MCP application containing clients, not the MCP server or a hosting machine. Shorten to المضيف when unambiguous.
Protocol/HTTP request; plural طلبات. A response is استجابة, a result is نتيجة.
OAuth: access token رمز وصول, refresh token رمز تحديث, bearer token رمز حامل. LLM token: وحدة نصية (token) on first use, then وحدة نصية. Do not conflate the two.
Server startup/shutdown feature. Preserve lifespan= and other identifiers.
Plural دوال رد نداء. OAuth callback URL is عنوان URL لرد النداء. First prose mention may take (callback).
Deploy a server: انشر الخادم. Deployment نشر; distinct from running locally, تشغيل.
Software library; plural مكتبات.
Server-to-client calls during a request; first prose mention takes (back-channel). Preserve NoBackChannelError.
Plural ملفات.
Plural مستخدمون / مستخدمين according to case. Distinct from client.
Lower-level API mechanism for bypassing convenience-layer restrictions. Translate metaphor by its function.
Python typing hint; plural تلميحات الأنواع. Type annotation is تعليق نوع when distinction matters; do not translate the identifier.
Guide section/index title; distinct from First steps.
Tutorial page inside Get started.
Verifying identity, distinct from authorization.
Granting/checking permission, distinct from authentication.
Request-processing middleware. A single middleware component is مكوّن وسيط.
Data/type schema; JSON Schema remains the name JSON Schema.
Tool output matching a schema; structured content is محتوى منظّم.
Protocol list pagination, not printed-page numbering.
Plural اشتراكات. Subscribe اشترك; unsubscribe ألغِ الاشتراك.
Protocol notification distinct from request and response.
Cancelling a request/task; preserve cooperative cancellation semantics.
No server-side state required between requests; statelessness انعدام الحالة.
Preserves state across requests; inflect for gender and number.
Signed assertion carrying authenticated identity; first prose occurrence may take (identity assertion).
MCP argument autocomplete إكمال تلقائي للوسائط; LLM completion استكمال يولّده النموذج. Preserve protocol/class identifiers.
Direct in-process test connection, without network transport or subprocess.
Older protocol path, not a judgement about quality. Legacy client عميل قديم. Preserve mode="legacy".
New protocol where clients fetch outstanding requests; contrast with server-initiated دفع (push).
Passed call value; plural وسائط. Parameter is مَعلمة, plural مَعلمات; preserve identifiers.
Streaming تَدَفّق / بث according to context; never translate the name Streamable HTTP.
Caching تخزين مؤقت; cached result نتيجة مخزّنة مؤقتًا.
